focus_pages.title: Accepted correction: two separate fronts
focus_pages.observation: Your two-cassette confirmation is now represented by two separate observed-front boxes. The lower box no longer spans the thumb. The old left point did not reliably locate the actual lower-front corner, so both fronts keep unlocatable slots as 0 0 0.
focus_pages.question: Cyan reflects a settled annotation decision. These objects remain valid training boxes even though neither actual corner can be reliably located.

focus_pages.title: Resolved 1: upper assembly is wall
focus_pages.observation: You identified this broad white assembly as wall. This exact region is non-target; no cassette row is added or changed. The accepted two-front correction beside the thumb is a separate decision.
focus_pages.question: The upper-assembly question in new_000037 is resolved. Position outside the rack is a supporting cue, not a rule excluding every held or off-rack cassette front.

focus_pages.title: Question 2: material confirmed; count open
focus_pages.observation: You confirmed shadowed cassette material through the gripper's opening. Its material identity is established; whether the lower triangle below about y483 is a second target front or another surface of the same cassette remains open. The proposed extra instance is still withheld.
focus_pages.question: Which physical front owns the lower triangle? A visible white shoulder can help identify a cassette, but is not required. No hidden corner becomes locatable through this clarification.

focus_pages.title: Question 3: a second front or a molded lip?
focus_pages.observation: The thin band in row24 below the larger right-hand front is visible, but its instance ownership is unclear. The same question remains in new116 and new123. No minimum-height or minimum-area exclusion has been adopted.
focus_pages.question: Is row24 a separate lower cassette, or the underside / molded lip of the cassette above? This decides whether to keep a separate object row or consolidate it.

focus_pages.title: Question 4: what owns the clipped strip?
focus_pages.observation: Row1 is a strip about five pixels high at the top frame; rows6 and9 have similar questions. Neighboring cassette size and position help test ownership, but do not establish a separate clipped front or an invisible corner. No size-based exclusion is adopted.
focus_pages.question: Does the strip belong to a preceding cassette whose front is mostly outside the image, or to the upper molding of the clear front below? A missing bottom corner alone does not decide its identity.
